- **Read first.** Read the card's body and EVERY comment yourself: triage's grade 6244939176, the seat's claim (first line `Claim:`) and this order. Check that the body is complete before you start.
- **Identity.** The PM's `Claim:` comment is your identity: `Branch:` `claude/issue-24239-public-form-grant-skill`, worktree `objectstack-issue-24239`. Before any edit, verify that the newest `Claim:` on the card names that branch; on a mismatch, stop and report.

- Run everything in the foreground. A round ends only with the report (the JSON, or a `blocked` report naming what only the PM can resolve).

## 1. Ruling — none on this card; the governing record is ADR-0056 Option A and the text PR #24237 left on `main`

No maintainer ruling on this card. The published promise must match what runs (NORTH-STAR rule 4: a published or governed text that contradicts the running contract is a product defect). The running contract is recorded: ADR-0056 Option A (the submit is authorized by the form's own declaration through `publicFormGrant`; `SecurityPlugin` admits on that grant alone, before any permission set resolves) and ADR-0138's fate row for the `guest_portal` name (kept, for the result masker only). PR #24237 (card 24130, merged `9975c26a`) already rewrote the two platform texts to say so: `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` (the paragraph ending 「The submit route derives a narrow `publicFormGrant: { object: 'showcase_inquiry' }` — create + read-back of the row it just made, and nothing else.」, about L47) and the `registerFormEndpoints` docstring in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (about L7314–L7331: 「The submit is authorized by the form's own declaration (ADR-0056 Option A) … The submit's context also names `guest_portal` in `permissions`. That name admits nothing. …」). The skill is the third text and still says the old thing.

**Deliverable:** ONE draft PR to `main`. Body line 1 `Fixes #24239`, line 2 `Clause-②: no`. One published file, `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, the public-form passage (L87–L89 today: 「These bypass `enforceAuth`, run under a synthetic `{ permissions: ['guest_portal'], anonymous: true }` execution context, and are intended for Web-to-Lead / Web-to-Case style flows.」), rewritten so that:
1. it names `publicFormGrant` (scoped to the form's target object; create plus read-back of the row it made, nothing else; decided before any permission set resolves) as what authorizes the submit;
2. it says what the `guest_portal` name does and does not do: it admits nothing; where a deployment registers a permission set under it, only that set's field permissions and capabilities feed the grant's result masker;
3. it stops implying that an author must declare a `guest_portal` set, and stops implying that the form falls open without one;
4. it keeps everything else in the passage that is still true (the field allow-list, the `beforeInsert` defaults hook, the walled-posture withholding, the contract pointers) — read the docs page and the docstring as `main` has them and keep the three texts saying the same thing in the skill's own register (an author-facing skill, terse, imperative);
5. **net line budget for the file: +2 lines at most** (415 lines today); token ceiling 6314 (4642 today, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`); the PR body reports the two readings os-dev.md requires for `skills/**` (the file's before/after line and token counts, and the whole package's — every `SKILL.md` under `skills/` summed). ⛔ No new section, no new example, no expansion beyond the sentence the card names: a small correction, not a rewrite. 预期落点是 `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`。若实测表明真正的生产者在别包,直接按生产者侧修,落点与理由写进报告和 PR 正文。

**Changeset:** `skills/**` publishes through `@objectstack/skills` (`packages/skills`): one `.changeset/24239-public-form-grant-skill.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, body shaped like `.changeset/23983-previous-null-on-insert.md` on `f1c0b5784` (a `docs(skills):` first line naming the file and the corrected claim, then `Clause-②: no`, then one paragraph of what was wrong and what the text says now — text only, nothing an author writes changes). ⛔ Not `skip-changeset`.

**Tier H governed (`skills/**`):** the PR body carries `## 维护者速读(草稿)` (five fixed parts: 改了什么 / 为什么改 / 风险与代价(含回滚) / 席位意见 left empty / 你要做的), in Chinese, from the business angle. Stay draft: the seat reviews the head in seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, then requests review from the two approver accounts; the landing waits for their word. The PR body ends with the session-URL attribution footer (AGENTS.md's form).

## 2. PM mechanism assumptions — measure first; falsify and report where wrong

- **(a) The passage is the only place in the published catalog that says it.** The seat's grep at `8eccf519`: `grep -rn "guest_portal\|publicFormGrant" skills/` → one hit, `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:88`; control `grep -rn "enforceAuth" skills/` hits. Re-run both; if another skill file carries the same claim, it is the same defect in the same family — fix it in this PR only if it is the same sentence (a mechanical in-place fix, no new file surface beyond `skills/**`), otherwise list it for the seat.
- **(b) What runs, measured by card 24130's dev** (`os-dev-report` 6244037824 on that card, out-of-scope finding 2): a clean and a forged submit both answer `201 { id }` with and without a `GuestPortalProfile`; an engine-side `beforeInsert` hook sees neither `permissions` nor `anonymous`. Do not re-measure the runtime; read `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` around the `publicFormGrant` admission (about L2412) only to quote the behaviour correctly.
- **(c) Gates that read this file** (the seat's derivation lists 31 commands, among them `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs`, `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:corpus-claim-drift`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:role-word`): `check:skill-docs` may regenerate `skills/objectstack-api/references/_index.md` (generator-owned); if it does, commit the regenerated file and say so — it is not an author edit.
- **(d) The file's last `main` touch, `2c9bf943` (2026-10-17), is the version script's frontmatter re-stamp**, not an author edit; the passage itself was last authored earlier. 基于合并后的代码工作,issue 引用的片段可能已变,先核对当前 main。
- **(e) Writes:** REST proxy through `scripts/pm/` tools only; budget 3 (`git push`, `pr_create` with assignee, the `os-dev-report` comment); report `api_writes` (count + endpoints) and `mcp_calls` (count + tool names; a write tool in the list means the report is refused).

## 3. PM suggested route — optional; measurement wins

- Replace the three lines with a sentence pair of the same length class: 「These bypass `enforceAuth`. The submit is authorized by the form's own declaration: the route hands the engine a `publicFormGrant` scoped to the form's target object (create plus read-back of the row it made, nothing else, decided before any permission set resolves). The context also names `guest_portal`; that name admits nothing — a permission set registered under it only feeds the grant's result masker. Intended for Web-to-Lead / Web-to-Case style flows.」 — then keep the rest of the paragraph as is.
- Keep the two `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/...` contract pointers; add no third pointer unless the sentence needs one and it costs no line.

## 4. Verification you owe

Derive at `8eccf519`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`. After the FINAL commit re-derive with no paths, run the local subset, capture each exit code before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`, and quote `git rev-parse --short HEAD` in the report and the PR body. Report `line_budget` (the file and the package, before/after, lines and tokens).

## 5. Report

Terminal JSON per `os-dev.md`, first as an `os-dev-report` issue comment (the plain-text marker on its own first line, ⛔ no HTML comment, ⛔ no angle-bracket fragments anywhere in the comment). Machine-checkable: `gates`, `line_budget`, `deviations`, `files_changed`. Your final message to the PM is that same JSON and nothing else.

## Four-axis framework (SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉 lines 241–261 on `origin/main` `8eccf519`, SKILL.md last touched `bd4276a91`, md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0`) — pasted verbatim; use it for any `open_questions`

**每个方案必须沿四条固定评估轴分析,这是决策分析的核心原则,不是可选项:**

- **实际业务需求** — 它服务的是**真实存在的业务场景**,
  还是投机性能力面?判据要求**实测**(谁在写这个键、谁在读、
  示例应用与真实部署的用法),「读起来像有用」不作数。这条轴会改变结论,不是陪衬。
- **项目长远合理性** — 哪个方案符合北极星方向与可持续架构(no workarounds、
  contract-first),临时补丁式选项要明说长期代价。
- **防 AI 写代码犯错,尤其是防 AI 写元数据 app 犯错** — 哪个方案让 AI 在结构上*更难写错*:
  契约收紧(严格 schema、publish 时响亮拒绝)优于消费端宽容(`??` 回退、静默容错)——
  宽容恰是 AI 批量犯错被掩盖的温床;声明即强制,绝不让 AI 声明一个运行时不兑现的能力。
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — **创业阶段聚焦原则**:创业项目先专注核心能力,能力扩张默认
  从紧,无拉动的声明面按 implementation-first 处置,已发布零消费能力不因沉没成本豁免。
  **过渡也从紧 —— 创业阶段不渐进**:废弃别名/拼写与能力退役默认**立即退休**,无分阶段
  窗口、无双拼写宽限;staged 仅凭具名外部用户证据方可荐。**新增门禁默认否**:门禁是只减
  不增的零件,例外只有维护者点名;荐新增门禁须引其点名原话,否则荐「不加」。

**基本裁决原则**:spec 声明 > 实现 > 文档面;声明而未兑现是实现缺口,补实现或退役,
⛔ 不在消费端收窄;未声明键随实现,文档随之。「声明即强制」只及 spec 与元数据契约、
运行时能力,⛔ 不及 AGENTS.md 这类给 agent 读的约定 —— 那些的读者是 agent,不是门禁。
推荐意见必须基于这四条轴给出理由;四轴冲突时如实呈现权衡,
交维护者拍板。
